title: Kept Between Us: Matthew and Jessica's Love Map
description: A couple-scoped path where two partners map what they are learning about each other - the kind of knowing that belongs to the dyad and to no one else
purpose: Build mutual understanding between partners through shared reflection - content whose reach is intimate: readable and writable by the couple, stewarded as opaque bytes by everyone else

chapters.title: What We Already Know
chapters.description: Shared ground - the household, the work, the years already mapped together

steps.stepNarrative: Start where the household economy actually runs - in the care work you both carry and rarely name.
learningObjectives: Name the care work each partner carries in the household
Agree on what deserves to be visible between you - and only between you

steps.stepNarrative: Some maps are drawn for the commons. This one is not. Reflect together on what intimacy means when your words are also bytes on someone else's device.
learningObjectives: Understand reach 'intimate' as the couple's boundary, enforced by the substrate
Trust that stewardship of your bytes never means access to your words
